sourceFacts.clockStamp: Unconditionally updates pty.lastOutputAt for every raw PTY chunk before normalization; mirrors at onto leaf.lastOutputAt. Installed bundle has the same behavior.
sourceFacts.quietGate: Date.now() - record.lastOutputAt must be at least quiescenceMs, which is 3000 in this runtime.
sourceFacts.composerRule: The strong idle composer verdict requiresQuiet; a visible matching composer does not bypass the clock.
sourceFacts.existingRelatedBehavior: references/orca/src/main/runtime/tui-idle-evidence.ts:298 already explains why OMP's periodic bracketed-paste reassertion prevents output quiescence; its alternative relies on an OMP-specific native idle title and is not proof for Antigravity.
sourceFacts.parserLimit: Existing scanner carries split CSI sequences but skips OSC/string and unknown ESC events; empty onText alone cannot safely classify a chunk as readiness-neutral.

replay.method: Parse util-linux script classic timing, segment the captured output by byte counts, then compare a 3000ms quiet window at 2-second poll times from 8 through 32 seconds.
selfChecksPassed: All timing byte ranges fit capture
At least ten identical protocol-only chunks
A quiet poll exists when only the observed protocol chunks are excluded
replay.limitation: This replay recognizes the exact complete chunks observed in this capture. It is not a production classifier, split-chunk validation, full VT emulator replay, public tui-idle PASS or Controller PASS.

conclusion: The independent native launch reproduces a mechanism sufficient to starve Orca's required quiet window: non-printing input-protocol settings repeat about every 2 seconds, while every chunk resets a 3-second timer. This agrees with the preserved fixture's output-clock samples and unchanged text cursor.
remainingUncertainty: Original live-process raw trace was unavailable. The diagnostic did not use the Companion launcher. Public screen projection still does not expose the exact trusted-grid verdict, so additional causes in the original fixture are not ruled out.

proposedRepair.owner: Orca native runtime, separate from Companion adapter and Controller
proposedRepair.principle: Preserve raw bytes, protocol handling and raw lastOutputAt; let readiness quiescence distinguish fully identified repeated input-protocol settings from other output activity.
constraints: Require the existing trusted idle-composer evidence
Count printable, clear-screen, buffer-switch, title, unknown and mixed output as activity
Keep parser state bounded and reset it for each PTY incarnation
No stream filtering or Companion readiness bypass
verificationNeeded: Unknown control sequences and incomplete escapes
Busy output, submit transition and startup/menu refusal
proposedRepair.implementationStatus: Proposal only; upstream and installed runtime remain unmodified.
